title: AI usage
description: See how much of your Claude and Codex limits is left this session and this week, how your pace compares, and when each resets, in the menu bar, as CodexBar shows it. Add a second Codex account with Codex's own sign-in.
examples: Glance at the menu bar: Claude's and Codex's logo with the session left, amber once a window is 60% used, red from 85%

Click it: a card per provider and Codex account with its plan, each window's share left draining, its pace tick (red in deficit) and its reset, the pace in words on hover; Claude's per-model week, Codex's limit reset credits with Redeem reset (asked first), and one row with each status page, the usage dashboards and Add Codex account

preferences.name: codexHomes
preferences.title: Codex accounts
preferences.description: Codex folders (CODEX_HOME) asked through Codex's own app-server, comma separated; Codex signs in with its own login. Accounts added with Add Codex account are asked too, and so is any other folder signed in to Codex (a ~/.codex-* or Pilot › AI's own) while List other Codex folders is on. A ~/.codex-* with logs but no login is listed from its session logs only.

preferences.name: barProviders
preferences.title: Menu bar shows
preferences.description: Which providers' figures the menu bar item shows. A click still shows every provider.

preferences.name: barWindow
preferences.title: Menu bar figure
preferences.description: The window behind each provider's figure: its session, as CodexBar shows it, or whichever window is the most used.

preferences.name: pace
preferences.title: Show pace
preferences.description: Each meter's mark where its usage should be by now, and its words: in reserve or in deficit, lasts until the reset or runs out when (on hover in the popover).

preferences.name: otherCodex
preferences.title: List other Codex folders
preferences.description: Also list Codex folders not in Codex accounts: each ~/.codex-* or Pilot › AI's own Codex home signed in to Codex is asked like the others, one with logs only is read from them.

preferences.name: gemini
preferences.title: Show Gemini
preferences.description: Gemini's card, shown only once the gemini CLI is installed; it says only that Gemini keeps no limit on this Mac.

commands.name: bar
commands.title: AI usage in the menu bar
